name: 1cP-AL-LAD
summary: 1cP-AL-LAD is a psychedelic substance belonging to the Lysergamides chemical class.

combinations.note: Uncertain or unpredictable interaction on PsychonautWiki.
Uncertain or unpredictable interaction on PsychonautWiki.

pharmacology.text: It is thought to act as prodrug of AL-LAD.

uses.text: The drug has been encountered as a novel designer drug.

summaryZh: 1cP-AL-LAD是一種有機化合物，化學式為C26H31N3O2，為迷幻藥物麥角酸二乙醯胺的衍生物和AL-LAD（6-烯丙基-6-去甲-LSD）的前藥，2021年6月在法國策劃藥黑市上發現。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its family, the lysergamides such as LSD, cause strong changes in perception and mood, and can bring anxiety, panic, confusion, a faster heartbeat and nausea. In some people they can trigger lasting mental health problems.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。同族的麥角醯胺類藥物（例如LSD）會強烈改變知覺與情緒，也可能帶來焦慮、恐慌、意識混亂、心跳加快與噁心。對部分人可能引發長期的心理健康問題。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。同族的麦角酰胺类药物（例如LSD）会强烈改变知觉与情绪，也可能带来焦虑、恐慌、意识混乱、心跳加快与恶心。对部分人可能引发长期的心理健康问题。

fact.en: The cP in its name is cyclopropanoyl, a small ring of three carbons attached to the indole nitrogen of AL-LAD, which the body is thought to strip off.
fact.zh: 名稱中的cP是環丙醯基，一個由三個碳組成的小環，接在AL-LAD的吲哚氮上，一般認為身體會把它切除。
fact.zhHans: 名称中的cP是环丙酰基，一个由三个碳组成的小环，接在AL-LAD的吲哚氮上，一般认为身体会把它切除。
